supplements.title: Factors associated with adherence to allocated treatment in the ASCEND trial: a mail-based randomised trial of aspirin and of omega-3 fatty acid supplementation in people with diabetes.
supplements.summary: The study identifies which patient factors predict whether people with diabetes stick with aspirin or omega-3 supplements in a large remote trial.

supplements.title: Betanin-encapsulated nanoparticles mitigate neurotoxicity against AlCl3-induced Alzheimer's disease via modulation of AChE/TNF-α/IL-1β expression.
supplements.summary: Betanin-loaded nanoparticles improved cognitive function and reduced inflammation in an Alzheimer's disease rat model by mitigating oxidative stress and neuroinflammatory responses.

supplements.title: Bio-mediated synthesis of zinc oxide nanoparticles from Crossandra infundibuliformis leaves: A potent inducer of apoptosis in lung cancer cells.
supplements.summary: Biosynthesized zinc oxide nanoparticles from Crossandra infundibuliformis leaves effectively induce apoptosis in lung cancer cells by triggering oxidative stress and genetic changes.

supplements.title: Pan-cancer multi-omics characterization of CDK12 and virtual screening of Vietnamese natural products for novel inhibitors.
supplements.summary: Researchers identified CDK12 as a key cancer driver across multiple tumor types and discovered promising natural compound inhibitors from Vietnamese medicinal herbs.

supplements.title: Protective effect and results of glutamine and partially hydrolyzed Guar gum on rats with experimental radiation enteritis.
supplements.summary: Glutamine and partially hydrolyzed guar gum did not significantly protect rats from radiation-induced intestinal damage when administered during experimental radiation enteritis.

supplements.title: LC-MS/MS-based metabolomics analysis and experimental verification reveal the mechanism of Dahuang Mudan Decoction inhibition with the proliferation of colorectal cancer cells.
supplements.summary: Dahuang Mudan Decoction, a traditional herbal treatment, demonstrates potential to inhibit colorectal cancer cell growth by disrupting key metabolic pathways.

supplements.title: Naringenin Alleviates 5-Fluorouracil-Induced Intestinal Mucositis via Modulating the Gut Microbiota, Bile Acid Metabolism, and PPAR Signaling Pathway.
supplements.summary: Naringenin reduces intestinal mucositis in chemotherapy by modifying gut bacteria, bile acids, and cellular pathways, potentially protecting patients from treatment-related digestive damage.

supplements.title: Withanolides from Physalis angulata as Potent Antimelanoma Agents: Activation of the p53 Pathway In Vitro and In Vivo.
supplements.summary: Specific withanolides from Physalis angulata effectively inhibit melanoma cell growth by activating the p53 pathway, demonstrating potential anti-cancer properties.

supplements.title: Diet, nutrition, and hormone therapy for prostate cancer: a systematic review with implications for future interventions.
supplements.summary: Given excellent prostate cancer outcomes, comorbidity management is critical to survivorship.

supplements.title: Anti-inflammatory effects of nicotinamide mononucleotide (NMN) in human skeletal muscle after BFR-exercise.
supplements.summary: NMN supplementation reduced inflammation in human skeletal muscle after blood flow restriction exercise, potentially offering a therapeutic approach for muscle recovery.

supplements.title: Taurine is a natural suppressor of urea cycle via targeting ASL.
supplements.summary: Taurine suppresses hepatocellular carcinoma tumor growth by targeting the ASL enzyme in the urea cycle, potentially offering a new therapeutic approach.

supplements.title: Fatty acid and cysteine metabolic interplay regulate ferroptosis and highlight xCT as a selenium-chrysin target in breast carcinoma.
supplements.summary: Cancer metabolic remodeling impacts the entire network of metabolic pathways, and strategies that target various points within this system could contribute to successfully abrogating cancer cell su...

supplements.title: Microenvironment-responsive EGCG-functionalized nanoplatform for synergistic photothermal-chemotherapy against triple-negative breast cancer.
supplements.summary: A multifunctional nanoplatform combining chemotherapy, photothermal therapy, and immune response activation significantly improved treatment outcomes for triple-negative breast cancer.

supplements.title: Potential Application of Natural Products in Weight Management and Obesity: Focusing on the Gut Microbiota.
supplements.summary: Natural products like polysaccharides and polyphenols can potentially help manage obesity by positively altering the gut microbiota's composition and diversity.

supplements.title: Polyphenol-Rich Coffee Leaf Extract Alleviates High-Fat Diet-Induced Intestinal Barrier Dysfunction through Modulation of Barrier Integrity, Enterohepatic Axis, and Gut Microbiota.
supplements.summary: Coffee leaf extract supplementation mitigates high-fat diet-induced intestinal damage, reduces inflammation, and improves gut microbiome health in mice.

off_label.title: Drug repurposing of ticagrelor suppresses renal cell carcinoma growth by blockading the EGFR/PI3K/AKT axis.
off_label.summary: Ticagrelor, an antiplatelet drug, slows kidney cancer growth by blocking a key cancer-promoting pathway.

off_label.title: Anti-diabetic drugs: a novel therapeutic approach against cisplatin-induced kidney injury, a mechanistic review of preclinical studies.
off_label.summary: Anti-diabetic drugs reduce kidney damage caused by cisplatin chemotherapy by lowering inflammation and oxidative stress in preclinical studies.

off_label.title: Global trends, knowledge structure, and thematic evolution of statin-cancer research: A comprehensive mapping and visualization study with insights from highly cited literature (1940-2025).
off_label.summary: Research shows statins may help prevent cancer, with studies increasingly focusing on breast cancer and translating findings into clinical treatments.

off_label.title: Harnessing endophytes and Multi-Omics for sustainable Colchicine biosynthesis.
off_label.summary: Endophytic microorganisms in Gloriosa superba enhance colchicine production through metabolic interactions, offering a sustainable approach to biosynthesis for medical treatments.

off_label.title: Sacubitril/valsartan as a modulator of pulmonary fibrosis: insights into Lnc-SNHG-16/miR-455 modulation and Notch/Smad-3 pathway inhibition.
off_label.summary: Sacubitril/valsartan reduces pulmonary fibrosis by targeting specific molecular pathways, potentially decreasing inflammation and fibrotic tissue development in lung disease.

off_label.title: Leveraging Naturally Assembled Tumor Extracellular Vesicles as Self-Adjuvanting Nanovaccines to Potentiate Cancer Immunotherapy via cGAS/STING Activation.
off_label.summary: Researchers transformed tumor cell waste into a cancer vaccine by loading extracellular vesicles with nanoparticles, effectively activating immune responses and enabling tumor eradication.

off_label.title: Sleep patterns and the risk of psoriatic disease: genetic predisposition and metabonomics.
off_label.summary: Sleep disruption may increase genetic risk and metabolic changes associated with developing psoriatic disease.

off_label.title: Efficacy and safety of baricitinib versus azathioprine, both combined with topical corticosteroids, in patients with moderate-to-severe atopic dermatitis: a single-centre randomized open-label trial.
off_label.summary: Baricitinib was found to be as effective and safe as azathioprine when combined with topical steroids for treating moderate-to-severe atopic dermatitis.

off_label.title: Elucidating key targets and mechanisms of diethyl phthalate-induced colorectal cancer through network toxicology and molecular docking.
off_label.summary: Diethyl phthalate (DEP), a widely used plasticizer with endocrine-disrupting properties, has raised concerns regarding its potential carcinogenic effects.

off_label.title: Theranostic and Radionuclide-based Treatment Approaches for Radioiodine-refractory Thyroid Cancer: From Biology to Clinical Application.
off_label.summary: Targeted radionuclide therapies and molecular imaging techniques offer new hope for treating radioiodine-refractory thyroid cancer by restoring iodine uptake and providing personalized treatment options.

off_label.title: Fatty acid and cysteine metabolic interplay regulate ferroptosis and highlight xCT as a selenium-chrysin target in breast carcinoma.
off_label.summary: Cancer metabolic remodeling impacts the entire network of metabolic pathways, and strategies that target various points within this system could contribute to successfully abrogating cancer cell su...

off_label.title: Manipulating metabolism-reprogrammed monocytic-MDSCs prevents colitis-associated dysplasia by IL-10/HIF-1α/DLL4 signaling.
off_label.summary: In colitis-associated colorectal cancer, blocking metabolism-altered monocytic immune cells and using a plant compound can prevent abnormal intestinal cell growth.

off_label.title: Colchicine-cinnamic acid hybrids with potent anticancer activities: synthesis, in vitro, and in vivo biological evaluations.
off_label.summary: Researchers developed a hybrid molecule (B7) combining colchicine and cinnamic acid that effectively disrupts cancer cell growth and shows promising antitumor activity in breast cancer.

off_label.title: A Multicenter Phase 2 Study of the Bruton's Tyrosine Kinase Inhibitor PCI-32765 (Ibrutinib) for Treatment of Relapsed Hairy Cell Leukemia
off_label.summary: Ibrutinib shows promise in treating relapsed hairy cell leukemia by blocking cancer cell growth enzymes.

off_label.title: Repurposing Tirazone as an effective quorum-sensing inhibitor against Pseudomonas aeruginosa virulence and biofilm formation.
off_label.summary: Tirazone effectively inhibits Pseudomonas aeruginosa quorum sensing, reducing virulence and biofilm formation, and enhancing antibiotic treatment in lab and animal models.

biomarkers.title: A mixed inflammatory peripheral signature defines clinical outcomes in a phase II trial combining pembrolizumab with paclitaxel and carboplatin in melanoma.
biomarkers.summary: Combining immunotherapy with chemotherapy didn't improve melanoma survival compared to immunotherapy alone, but blood markers identified treatment responders.

biomarkers.title: Alcohol consumption in metabolic dysfunction-associated steatotic liver disease (MASLD): understanding the gut-liver crosstalk for clinical translation.
biomarkers.summary: Researchers found that gut bacteria changes contribute to liver disease caused by alcohol and metabolic problems, suggesting microbiome treatments may help.

biomarkers.title: Axillary treatment options in clinically nodes-positive breast cancer whose nodes become pathologically nodes-negative after neoadjuvant chemotherapy: a pairwise and network meta-analysis.
biomarkers.summary: Study identifies the best axillary treatment approach for breast cancer patients whose lymph nodes clear after chemotherapy.

biomarkers.title: Drug repurposing of ticagrelor suppresses renal cell carcinoma growth by blockading the EGFR/PI3K/AKT axis.
biomarkers.summary: Ticagrelor, an antiplatelet drug, slows kidney cancer growth by blocking a key cancer-promoting pathway.

biomarkers.title: Comparative burden and projections of chewing tobacco-attributable lip/oral cavity and esophageal cancers: global and China-specific trends, 2000-2036.
biomarkers.summary: Chewing tobacco causes growing lip, oral, and esophageal cancer burden globally, with particularly concerning trends projected for China through 2036.

biomarkers.title: Economic evaluation of perioperative pembrolizumab plus standard of care as treatment for resectable locally advanced head and neck squamous cell carcinoma in the United States.
biomarkers.summary: Perioperative pembrolizumab plus standard treatment improved survival and proved cost-effective for resectable advanced head and neck cancer.

biomarkers.title: Molecular targeted therapy in combination with chemotherapy for the treatment of platinum-resistant/refractory ovarian cancer (PROC): a systematic review and network meta-analysis.
biomarkers.summary: Combining targeted therapy with chemotherapy improves treatment outcomes for platinum-resistant ovarian cancer compared to chemotherapy alone.

biomarkers.title: Design, synthesis and antiproliferative activity of oxadiazole derivatives as potent glycogen synthase kinase-3/histone deacetylase 6 dual inhibitors.
biomarkers.summary: Researchers designed a new compound that simultaneously blocks two cancer-related proteins, showing strong activity against stomach cancer cells.

biomarkers.title: Impact of breast biopsy markers on magnetic resonance-guided focused ultrasound.
biomarkers.summary: Breast biopsy markers may interfere with focused ultrasound treatment, requiring further investigation before clinical use.

biomarkers.title: Mapping research trends in esophageal cancer immunotherapy: A decade of thematic evolution and emerging priorities.
biomarkers.summary: Immunotherapy research for esophageal cancer has surged since 2019, with focus shifting from checkpoint inhibitors to tumor microenvironment mechanisms.

biomarkers.title: Anti-diabetic drugs: a novel therapeutic approach against cisplatin-induced kidney injury, a mechanistic review of preclinical studies.
biomarkers.summary: Anti-diabetic drugs reduce kidney damage caused by cisplatin chemotherapy by lowering inflammation and oxidative stress in preclinical studies.

biomarkers.title: Low Prevalence and Inconsistency of LRP4-IgG Detection in Suspected Myasthenia Gravis: A Multicenter CBA Comparison.
biomarkers.summary: LRP4-IgG antibodies are rarely and inconsistently detected in myasthenia gravis patients using current testing methods.

biomarkers.title: Immune checkpoint inhibitor-induced myocarditis is dependent on CD8 T cell-derived TNF and TNFR2 signaling.
biomarkers.summary: Blocking TNF signaling in immune cells prevents heart damage from cancer immunotherapy while maintaining anti-tumor effectiveness.

biomarkers.title: N-acetyl-aspartyl-glutamate connects neuroinflammatory signatures to attention and working memory in people with HIV.
biomarkers.summary: A brain chemical called NAAG links inflammation to memory and attention problems in people with HIV, even when the virus is controlled.

biomarkers.title: Approaches for Lung Fiducial Markers Insertion in Stereotactic Body Radiotherapy: A Systematic Review and Meta-Analysis.
biomarkers.summary: Fiducial markers inserted via three different approaches improve radiation tracking accuracy for lung cancer treatment in inoperable patients.

trials.title: A mixed inflammatory peripheral signature defines clinical outcomes in a phase II trial combining pembrolizumab with paclitaxel and carboplatin in melanoma.
trials.summary: Combining immunotherapy with chemotherapy didn't improve melanoma survival compared to immunotherapy alone, but blood markers identified treatment responders.

trials.title: Quantitative live-cell imaging of auxin and cytokinin signalling in developing feeding sites of Heterodera schachtii.
trials.summary: Cytokinin signaling precedes auxin signaling in nematode-induced feeding structures, with cytokinin activating broadly while auxin remains localized to infection sites.

trials.title: Axillary treatment options in clinically nodes-positive breast cancer whose nodes become pathologically nodes-negative after neoadjuvant chemotherapy: a pairwise and network meta-analysis.
trials.summary: Study identifies the best axillary treatment approach for breast cancer patients whose lymph nodes clear after chemotherapy.

trials.title: Association between hypothermic machine perfusion parameters and graft function in deceased donor kidney transplantation.
trials.summary: Hypothermic machine perfusion improves kidney transplant function by reducing injury compared to traditional cold storage methods.

trials.title: On-label persistence in psoriasis after switching to guselkumab, tumor necrosis factor inhibitors, interleukin-17 inhibitors, or apremilast from other advanced therapies.
trials.summary: Guselkumab showed better treatment persistence in psoriasis patients compared to other advanced therapies when switching treatments.

trials.title: Economic evaluation of perioperative pembrolizumab plus standard of care as treatment for resectable locally advanced head and neck squamous cell carcinoma in the United States.
trials.summary: Perioperative pembrolizumab plus standard treatment improved survival and proved cost-effective for resectable advanced head and neck cancer.

trials.title: Current landscape of clinical trials for mRNA-based therapeutics.
trials.summary: mRNA-based therapeutics show expanding clinical potential beyond COVID-19 vaccines, with 557 trials mostly focusing on infectious diseases and vaccines.

trials.title: Secondary poor graft function after autologous stem cell transplantation in multiple myeloma: a case-based expert review and successful rescue with secondary autologous stem cell infusion.
trials.summary: Doctors successfully treated rare blood cell recovery failure in multiple myeloma patients by infusing additional stem cells after initial transplant.

trials.title: Dynamic trends and determinants of COVID-19 vaccine hesitancy among adults in China during 2021-2022: A multilevel analysis based on four national cross-sectional surveys.
trials.summary: This is a COVID-19 vaccine study, not cancer research. It examines vaccine hesitancy trends among Chinese adults from 2021-2022, finding hesitancy rose and fell with pandemic phases and perception changes.

trials.title: Molecular targeted therapy in combination with chemotherapy for the treatment of platinum-resistant/refractory ovarian cancer (PROC): a systematic review and network meta-analysis.
trials.summary: Combining targeted therapy with chemotherapy improves treatment outcomes for platinum-resistant ovarian cancer compared to chemotherapy alone.

trials.title: Mapping research trends in esophageal cancer immunotherapy: A decade of thematic evolution and emerging priorities.
trials.summary: Immunotherapy research for esophageal cancer has surged since 2019, with focus shifting from checkpoint inhibitors to tumor microenvironment mechanisms.

trials.title: Telenursing and Self-Efficacy in Heart Failure.
trials.summary: Telephone nursing support significantly improved self-efficacy and reduced symptoms in chronic heart failure patients.

trials.title: Assessment of Compliance with Nursing Care Documentation for Patients with Acute Coronary Syndrome Using the Clinical Care Classification System in the Emergency Department: A Descriptive and Directed Content Analysis Study.
trials.summary: Nursing documentation for emergency heart attack patients showed only 27% compliance with a standardized classification system, revealing significant room for improvement.

trials.title: Approaches for Lung Fiducial Markers Insertion in Stereotactic Body Radiotherapy: A Systematic Review and Meta-Analysis.
trials.summary: Fiducial markers inserted via three different approaches improve radiation tracking accuracy for lung cancer treatment in inoperable patients.

trials.title: Rectal Arteriovenous Malformation Mimicking a Submucosal Tumor: Successful Long-Term Outcome After Transcatheter Arterial Embolization With N-Butyl-2-Cyanoacrylate-Lipiodol.
trials.summary: Transcatheter arterial embolization successfully treated a rectal arteriovenous malformation that mimicked a tumor, with no recurrence after three years.
